title: gui: two panels still render the `ui_kit::not_ready` scaffold ("this view lands with card …") in their no-analysis state
description:
[found by VER-3's GUI verification pass · see board/docs/verification-v2.md §8.3]
Seats: GRAPH-02 (crates/gui/src/diagrams/control.rs) + TEXT-02 (crates/gui/src/usage/variables.rs); ui_kit owner: integrator.

LOW-SEVERITY HONESTY DEFECT. The v2 GUI panels have landed and render real core data, but two of them still fall back to the parallel-development scaffold `ui_kit::not_ready()` when `app.analysis` is `None`:
  * crates/gui/src/diagrams/control.rs:48-55 -> `ui_kit::not_ready(ui, "Control-flow diagrams", "GRAPH-2", "no analysis yet — press Learn …")`
  * crates/gui/src/usage/variables.rs:64-72 -> `ui_kit::not_ready(ui, "Variables", "TEXT-2", "no analysis yet — press Learn first")`
`ui_kit::not_ready` (crates/gui/src/ui_kit.rs:14-37) always renders the line `this view lands with card {card}`. For a repo that opened index-only (the read-only-repo fallback in app.rs:196-211 sets index but an empty `Analysis`), these two panels therefore tell the user the view has NOT shipped, when in fact only the analysis artifact is missing. The sibling panels got this right with honest empty-state cards that name the missing artifact (see diagrams/types.rs:237 and diagrams/modules.rs:257, which deliberately do NOT use `not_ready`; usage/refs.rs:203 and notes.rs:382 say "no analysis yet — …").

Repro: open a repo that cannot be analyzed (read-only copy, or a tree with no analyzable files), then open Diagrams -> Control flow or the sidebar Usage -> Variables tab. Observed text: "this view lands with card GRAPH-2" / "this view lands with card TEXT-2" instead of "no analysis yet".

Deliverable: replace the two `ui_kit::not_ready(...)` calls with an honest empty-state card that names the missing analysis (mirroring `empty_notice_names_core_9` / `empty_notice_names_the_type_card`), or delete `ui_kit::not_ready` if it has no remaining honest caller. Keep the panels' real rendering unchanged.
Verify: on a no-analysis repo, Control-flow and Variables name the missing analysis artifact and never contain the substring "lands with card"; `grep -rn 'lands with card' crates/gui/src` -> 0 hits on any reachable path.
